notes: v1.65: Per-lane window instance pinning. Each lane now stores target_window_instance — which Nth match of the title substring it bound to at pick time. Pick/Capture/Drag all auto-compute the instance index. resolve_lane_hwnd uses (title, instance) so Secondary/Third reliably bind their own distinct windows even after restart. Skip_hwnds fallback still ensures uniqueness when instance pins collide.
